items.title: Ajax football club hack exposed fan data, enabled ticket hijack
items.description: Dutch professional football club Ajax Amsterdam (AFC Ajax) disclosed that a hacker exploited vulnerabilities in its IT systems and accessed data belonging to a few hundred people. [...]

items.title: Is the FCC's Router Ban the Wrong Fix?
items.description: The agency put foreign-made consumer routers on its list of prohibited communications devices, but the ban could create more problems down the road.

items.title: Automotive Cybersecurity Threats Grow in Era of Connected, Autonomous Vehicles
items.description: More than a decade since the 2015 Jeep hack, the cybersecurity of vehicles remains of the utmost importance.

items.title: New ClickFix Attack Leverage Windows Run Dialog Box and macOS Terminal to Deploy Malware
items.description: A social engineering technique called ClickFix has resurfaced with significant force, tricking users on both Windows and macOS into manually executing malicious commands that quietly install malware on their devices. First documented in late 2023, the method has rapidly grown from a niche tactic into one of the most widely adopted initial access strategies across […] The post New ClickFix Attack…

items.title: Leak Bazaar Turns Stolen Corporate Data Into a Structured Criminal Marketplace
items.description: A threat actor known as “Snow” from SnowTeam posted an advertisement on the Russian-speaking TierOne (T1) cybercrime forum on March 25, 2026, introducing a new criminal service called Leak Bazaar. The platform is not a traditional data leak site. Instead, it presents itself as a post-exfiltration processing service — one that takes raw stolen corporate […] The post Leak Bazaar Turns Stolen…

items.title: VoidLink Rootkit Uses eBPF and Kernel Modules to Hide Deep Inside Linux Systems
items.description: A new and technically advanced rootkit called VoidLink has emerged as a serious threat to Linux systems, blending Loadable Kernel Modules (LKMs) with extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) programs to hide deep inside the operating system’s core. First documented by Check Point Research in January 2026, VoidLink is a cloud-native Linux malware framework written in […] The post VoidLink Rootkit…

items.title: CISA: New Langflow flaw actively exploited to hijack AI workflows
items.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning that hackers are actively exploiting a critical vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-33017, which affects the Langflow framework for building AI agents. [...]

items.title: Critical Flaw in Langflow AI Platform Under Attack
items.description: Threats actors pounced on the code injection vulnerability within hours of its disclosure, demonstrating that organizations have little time to address critical bugs.

items.title: China-Linked Red Menshen Uses Stealthy BPFDoor Implants to Spy via Telecom Networks
items.description: A long-term and ongoing campaign attributed to a China-nexus threat actor has embedded itself in telecom networks to conduct espionage against government networks. The strategic positioning activity, which involves implanting and maintaining stealthy access mechanisms within critical environments, has been attributed to Red Menshen, a threat cluster that's also tracked as Earth Bluecrow,

items.title: ZDI-CAN-29544: Meta
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Mat Powell of TrendAI Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-03-26, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-07-24 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
